reported.title: Toggles on release edge instead of press, with no debounce
reported.description: The loop only calls flipLed() when risingEdge() detects a LOW-to-HIGH transition (lines 26-29, 54-57), i.e. on key release, not on the active-LOW press; this inverts the intended edge and lets release bounce toggle the LED. There is no 40 ms settle/debounce window anywhere in loop() (lines 50-58), so every bounce transition is counted, producing measured toggle counts of [2,2,3,...] and [3,3,3,3] per press plus spurious toggles with no press (e.g. 'D13 toggled at 952 ms with no press to explain it'). The bounce-tail scenario measured 0 toggles for the press itself while 5 unexplained toggles occurred, confirming the edge logic fires on the wrong transitions. 15 of 15 press(es) did not toggle D13 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [2, 2, 3, 2, 2, 3, 3, 2, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2]. D13 also toggled 9 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 952 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Panel key on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); status LED on D13.
- Each settled press toggles D13 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Use a 40 ms settle window before accepting a press edge (HIGH-to-LOW after settle).
- Print `panel led=<0|1> edges=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Idle (unpressed) key reads HIGH.
